description: AABB-accredited facilities from AABB's public lists: blood banks, transfusion services and blood centers, immunohematology and molecular labs, perioperative and out-of-hospital transfusion, cord blood, HPC and cell therapy facilities, and relationship (DNA) testing labs. Per facility: name, city, state, country, AABB codes, and website and phone for DNA labs. Filter by state, country or name. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

country.description: Country code as AABB lists it, e.g. USA, CAN, SAU

state.description: US state / province code, e.g. TX

type.description: blood-bank, immunohematology-reference, molecular-testing, perioperative, out-of-hospital-transfusion, cord-blood, hpc, somatic-cell, cell-therapy-services, dna-testing (default blood-bank)
